articles.summary: CPI Card Group, a payments technology leader providing a comprehensive range of physical and digital payment solutions, today announced a partnership with Bankjoy, a leading provider of digital banking solutions for community banks and credit unions. Through the partnership, Bankjoy clients can offer CPI Push Provisioning, giving customers a quick, secure way to add debit and credit cards to digital wallets directly from their financial institution’s app or online banking portal.
articles.title: Bankjoy Partners with CPI to Bring Push Provisioning to Community Banks and Credit Unions
